[P2] Preserve explicit semantics when replacing a config

`replace(StepConfig(), step_semantics=StepSemantics.AT_LEAST_ONCE)` still retains `_step_semantics_set=False`. With an async execution default, `DurableContext.step` therefore overwrites this explicit synchronous choice with `AT_LEAST_ONCE_ASYNC`. An idempotency-key step can return before persistence despite the caller pinning its semantics, permitting duplicate downstream side effects after interruption and replay. The added documentation acknowledges this limitation but leaves the failure intact. Rework inheritance resolution so explicit replacement values override the execution default, and add a regression test for this replacement case.
